titles.title: Untitled (Abstraction Two Green Lines Small Red Circle)

credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Two patches of green paint run vertically down the paper.  A red circle is located in between the green patches. This artwork is on the back of *Untitled (Abstraction Green Line and Red Circle)*, 1979 (cat. no. 1640).
